text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's Ines Fujin! Ines Fujin has won<n>the Arima!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Siiiiis!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Congrats! You did it!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Haha, is that Ines's little sister? Well,<n>Ines sure
was amazing today!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Totally. I think seeing her run like thatgave me the strength to actually getthrough all my snoozefest shifts.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Oho. Pretty brave of you to say that<n>with me
standing right here.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a sec! I didn't mean it that<n>way! I just
meant I feel like I can get<n>through anything life
throws at me!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I know what you mean.<n>Watching Ines run
really does make<n>you feel alive, huh?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Totally. Makes me feel like we shouldbe chasing after our dreams too—like,for real.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I guess you're carrying a lot of<n>weight too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wha?! H-hi, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I need to move forward too. I want to<n>let them
dream again.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like this isn't over after all.<n>Not yet. Let's
meet again, Ines. Right<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: O-okay? ...I'm looking forward to it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Let them dream, huh...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Sis...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Cassie...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Keep running a whole lot, okay? Me<n>and Polly...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: We love you! And we love how hard<n>you work!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I will.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But can I ask you two a favor?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Cassie, Polly, I want you to keep<n>helping me out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you can take care of<n>things around the
house for now?<n>That way I can keep on racing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Can I count on you two?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What's up, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's run for their dreams too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: We'll keep running, and we'll have a blast doing it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!
